text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty-then! Now we combine the milk and 
butter in a fusion-gattai!! Amount? The 
amount is~... pouring in ALL the passion 
you've got-deesu!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Th-This time, please stick to 60 ml of 
milk!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hundara~ hendaraa~... 
O spirits, reveal to me the ultimate 
recipe~... Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What's this!? Gâteau au chocolat is a 
Great Blessing!? 
Quick, fetch the granulated sugar...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
N-No, Fukukitaru, today we're making basic 
chocolate...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ Melting dear, you are <italics>bellissimo</italics>~♪ 
Transform into the <italics>dolce sapore dell'amore</italics> 
~♪

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...At this point, I shall "retrieve" the 
bowl of chocolate from Sounds of Earth—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"A-And so, episode two was all about 
how to make basic ganache chocolate...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Arrangements are up to you! Shape your 
sweets to the rhythm of your heart, and 
let your ensemble of feelings resonate on 
Valentine's Day!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, we'll be showing you 
how to do gift wrapping-maasu! Tune in, 
everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text: ...Wrapping, huh...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Where on earth are we headed...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Where? Didn't we come to pick out wrapping 
paper-desuka? 
Look, I found some great paper! Let's buy 
around 10 meters-mashou!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
10 meters...!? The script just calls for 
regular wrapping, doesn't it? 
We shouldn't need anywhere near that—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem! When it comes to wrapping, 
looks are everything! I'll make it as big 
and special as Mt. Fuji-maasu!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case! How about we recreate 
the beauteous cityscape of Venezia with 
our wrapping?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... If we're making Mt. Fuji, a hawk 
and eggplants are essential! To complete 
the Lucky Bermuda Triangle, we'll need 
purple paper too—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
<italics>Meraviglioso</italics>! Decorating with colorful 
musical notes wouldn't be bad either! An <italics> 
orchestra</italics> of colors!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sfera. ...Recreating the "event horizon" 
with "wrapping."

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm... maybe I'll go with this one... 
And for the ribbon... Eek.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oops, excuse me! 
Were you looking for wrapping paper as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, could it be that you're... 
having trouble with Valentine's wrapping!?

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, n-no, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Valentine troubles-desuka!? 
Then we'll solve it in a flash with a BANG 
and a BOOM!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Let me hear it! Tell me all about your 
troubled feelings!"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeek?! W-Who are you people?!\nAre you 
extorting my troubles from me?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Mm-hmm, I see, I see~! So you want to 
give a letter\nand some chocolates to your 
upperclassman, is that it?!"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes... She's helped me out with so 
much, but when I actually tried to write 
the letter, I couldn't put my feelings 
into words..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, mmm... In that case, why not 
let\nthe gods write it for you?!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Like a Kokkuri-san session! If we ask, 
'How do I feel about my senpai~?',\nI'm 
sure a thank-you letter will be produced 
automatically...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Fukukitaru... Even if by some miracle 
that worked,\nthat's pretty much a 
curse..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe and you 
are—"synchronized".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"An attempt to 'linguistically translate' 
a 'signal'—\nalways generates 
'distortion'."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"That—drastically narrows down 
'coherence'.\nBefore the 'Roche limit', 
everyone comes to a standstill—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Even so—Neo Universe wants to 
'believe'.\nThat by continuing to aim for 
it, the possibility of the 'sun, moon, and 
stars'—remains."

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"......... I-I'm so sorry.\nI... I didn't 
quite understand what you meant..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Auugh...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"No—Miss Universe made a truly wonderful 
point!\nSometimes, words can be the very 
source of uncouth frustration—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Because feelings are not meant to be 
reasoned out—\nthey are meant to be 
conveyed upon the wings of one's own 
burning passion!"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"B-But... how am I supposed to do 
that...?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Then—I shall beat out the rhythm in your 
stead.\nNow—surrender yourself to this 
melodia—"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"Ngh... T-This song is...?!\nI-I suddenly 
feel so romantic...?!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Is your heart beginning to dance? Then, 
step by step is fine—\nAppassionato! 
Surrender yourself to the rhythm!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh! It's just like a snake charmer 
controlling a snake with music, yes?!"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text: "I... I actually wrote it..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, a melodia connecting heart to 
heart!\nThat is the very ensemble I 
desire!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Now, all that's left is to give it on 
Valentine's Day!\nYou'll join us, won't 
you? In this orchestra of feelings...!"

text_block_list.name: Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"...I really can't do this after 
allllll!!"
